label: Concreteness of necessary actual parts in the selected fusion scope
term: Concreteness of necessary actual parts in the selected fusion scope
definition: Every p that exists at w, satisfies NecessaryAt from w, and lies in the selected fusion part scope satisfies m.concrete.
note: This explicit calibration allows other actual bearers, and nonnecessary parts, to be abstract. It expresses CONCRETE_6 at the supplied Profile and leaves the Ontic and world fixed.
